'''The Shepherd''' is an NPC in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' who is first mentioned in during the {{Quest|Ominous Star}}.

Although not a real person, they are made up by [[Scar]] through his interpretation of [[Qichi Village]]'s dark story.

==Trivia==
*It is currently unknown who The Shepherd represents aside from the "black lamb," who represents Scar and [[Rover]]. However, it is implied that The Shepherd could represent or might be the true identity of [[Phrolova]], which is hinted to her ability in controlling [[Echoes]] and [[Tacet Discord]]s alike through her Lycoris wand. Alternatively, the Shepherd is no one in particular and merely a representation of authority figures that Scar opposes.
